exposure: Mucoadhesive polymeric systems for vaginal drug delivery
outcome: Prevention and treatment of conditions (STIs, hormonal treatment, birth control, cancer treatment)
cohort: The review focuses on information regarding vaginal drug delivery for women.
finding: Intravaginal drug administration, particularly using mucoadhesive polymeric systems, offers a reliable alternative for medication with stable and prolonged results, requiring lower doses and avoiding the first-pass effect.
